router.get('/notes/:noteId/attachments/:attachmentId/download', requireAuth, (req, res) => { const noteId = Number.parseInt(req.params.noteId, 10); const attachmentId = Number.parseInt(req.params.attachmentId, 10); if (!Number.isInteger(noteId) || !Number.isInteger(attachmentId)) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid attachment id.' }); const attachment = getNoteAttachmentById(attachmentId, req.user!.id); if (!attachment || attachment.note_id !== noteId) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Attachment not found.' }); const filePath = path.join(noteUploadsDir, attachment.stored_name); if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'File missing on server.' }); return res.download(filePath, attachment.original_name); });
